mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >60% of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (exceeding 0.25% in a single month) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing short-term equity sell-off and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS rise >0.25pp instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering short-term equity sell-off and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline and RSAFS decline in prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >60% of HOUST and RSAFS decline periods or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE above 5.0%) leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring, depressing near-term equity returns and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns positive in >60% of UNRATE > 5.0 periods or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >60% of INDPRO < 95.0 periods or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 550,000 units signal severe residential construction slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to broader economic weakness.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns positive in >60% of HOUST < 550.0 instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signal inflation-fighting monetary policy, leading to equity market correction and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS>0.5% and CPIAUCSL>3.0% periods or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 > 12900 billion and HOUST > 600.0 thousand) lead to profit-taking and policy pivot anticipation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns positive in >60% of GDPC1>12900.0 and HOUST>600.0 periods or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
